parameters.content: ## CURRENT LIFECYCLE — one routed stage\nBuild lifecycle view derives a display-only view from the assembled snapshot. Current Stage Router sends each refresh to exactly one lifecycle indicator (or Attention / Unresolved). Green here means the routed presentation received data; it never launches, retries, resumes, promotes, or mutates runtime state.\nThe row is presentation order only: REJECT branches below the decision point; PASS → Survivor → Leaderboard → Private Repo is the promoted display path. The router fans out to one indicator, so stage nodes do not execute as a second state machine.

## SOURCE / METRICS REFRESH — read-only observation\nEvery source node reads host state read-only (cat/ls/wc/sha256sum). Green execution here means only source read succeeded; it is not lifecycle activity.\nNo pipeline, Kanban, candidate, leaderboard, results-root or GitHub state is written. The only write is the snapshot file in the n8n deployment shadow dir.
